## 中文原文
午休的时候，你坐在工位，本来打算小睡一会儿。结果刷手机翻看以前的聊天记录，看得入了神。等反应过来，午休时间已经结束，你根本没来得及休息

## My translation
During the lunch break, I'd planned to snap for a while.
I ended up scrolling through the chat history in the phone.
I was too focused to forget the time.
By the time I realized, lunch break was over, and I hadn't had a chance to rest.

## Revised version
During the lunch break, I'd planned to squeeze in a quick nap.
Instead, I found myself scrolling through the chat history on my phone.
I got so absorbed that I lost track of time.
Before I knew it, the lunch break was over, and I hadn't gotten any time to rest at all.

## Key phrases
- squeeze in a quick nap
- so absorbed that...
- lost track of time, 忘记时间
